answer: What survives to the harbor is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Every claim climbs the umber of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the kernel re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, forfeited on duplicate submission. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
